antes.anibia-2026: A dark comedy about humankind’s desire to love and to be loved. Centred around neediness, intimacy and romance.  Told through a series of loosely connected, tender and absurd scenes, the film follows people who are searching for closeness and acceptance. In a world that preaches self-control, the film explores the sides we try to hide, such as feeling needy and pathetic.  The stories overlap and reappear, gradually forming a portrait of collective longing.
